verdict.rationale: LibreOffice runs entirely on the user's own infrastructure. Its source is public on GitHub (LibreOffice/core), and it is free with "unfettered access". Headless mode lets it run on a server under API or CLI control, and a hands-on user reports running it in Docker for PDF generation and format normalization. missing for 10: first-party server/container deployment guide or official image, build-from-source instructions in the pack.
